Not sent — the cost changed before it went out. Your wallet paid for the key exchange that goes first, but not for this photo, file or voice note. Tap Retry to see the new price.
Not sent — this chat was switched to Shielded while this was uploading, and a Shielded send has a price. Nothing was paid. Tap Retry to see the price.

In a Shielded chat, the link to a photo, file or voice note travels inside a Zcash transaction, which costs at least %1$s ZEC. Your wallet can spend %2$s ZEC right now. Nothing was uploaded or paid. Add ZEC, or switch this chat to Tunnel or Open: there these are free, and their link goes through the relays instead.
Not sent — your ZEC is still confirming. Nothing was paid. Tap Retry once it has confirmed, or switch this chat to Tunnel or Open, where photos, files and voice notes are free.
Not sent — not enough ZEC for a Shielded send. Nothing was paid. Add ZEC, then tap Retry.
